recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片中細胞沿抹片條帶分布、細胞量高，散佈許多體積大的巨核細胞，左側還有巨核細胞聚集成群，提示巨核細胞增生，符合 MDS/MPN 伴環狀鐵粒母細胞與血小板增多的骨髓表現。
features: Low-power aspirate with cellular trails of hematopoietic cells
Increased numbers of megakaryocytes scattered across the field
Megakaryocytes vary in size, including large forms, with a loose cluster at the left edge
Mixed myeloid and erythroid precursors in the background
Individual cytologic detail (dysplasia, ring sideroblasts) not assessable at this magnification
describe_en: Low-power bone marrow aspirate smear shows cellular trails with abundant hematopoietic elements. Megakaryocytes are conspicuously increased, varying in size and including large forms, with a loose cluster at the left margin. Cytologic detail such as dysplasia cannot be evaluated at this magnification. The findings of megakaryocytic hyperplasia are consistent with a myeloproliferative component and, together with ring sideroblasts and thrombocytosis, support myelodysplastic/myeloproliferative neoplasm with ring sideroblasts and thrombocytosis.

ddx.vs: ET also shows increased large megakaryocytes but lacks erythroid dysplasia and ≥15% ring sideroblasts on iron stain.
PMF megakaryocytes are atypical with cloud-like hyperchromatic nuclei in dense clusters, with granulocytic proliferation and reticulin fibrosis on biopsy.
ITP shows increased megakaryocytes with thrombocytopenia rather than thrombocytosis and no dysplasia or ring sideroblasts.
